one_line: Pallava king and temple-builder of Kanchipuram, patron of the Kailasanathar and Shore Temple.

appearance.age_look: early 30s, lean but strong build, upright royal posture
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, medium brown South Indian complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly groomed short beard and moustache, expressive large anime-style eyes with calm, contemplative gaze, default expression a composed half-smile showing quiet confidence
appearance.hair: thick black hair drawn up into a high, smooth topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow gold band; simple central part at the front with short, tidy locks framing the temples; no crown, only a slender golden diadem band with a tiny central leaf-shaped ornament
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Pallava royal attire: a cream-colored, finely woven cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and across the torso like a shawl, leaving the chest modestly covered; beneath it a fitted, pale gold short-sleeved upper garment suggested under the drape; lower garment is a richly pleated dhoti of deep maroon cotton wrapped around the waist and falling to the ankles, with a broad border in muted gold and thin dark-green stripes; the dhoti front is carefully fan-pleated in classic South Indian style; bare feet are avoided—he wears simple brown leather sandals with toe loop; jewellery includes a layered set of modest gold necklaces (one short collar, one longer with a small Shiva-linga pendant), slim gold armlets on both upper arms, and several thin gold bangles on each wrist; small, round gold stud earrings; a narrow, patterned cloth belt in dark green with tiny repeating geometric motifs ties the dhoti at the waist; on the forehead a thin horizontal white tripundra line with a small red dot at the center, drawn in soft, dignified style.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved steel sword in a plain dark-brown wooden scabbard with modest brass fittings, carried at his left hip; when visible, the hilt has a simple disk pommel and short crossguard, wrapped in dark cloth, symbolizing royal martial authority rather than aggressive battle.

ref_desc: Narasimhavarman II Rajasimha is a lean, bearded Pallava king with a high black topknot and gold band, wearing cream angavastra, deep maroon dhoti with gold and green border, modest gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a plain curved sword at his left hip in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Narasimhavarman II Rajasimha: a dignified Pallava king in his early thirties, lean but strong, with an oval medium-brown South Indian face, high cheekbones, straight nose, and neat short beard and moustache. His eyes are large and expressive, set in a calm, contemplative half-smile. His thick black hair is pulled into a high, smooth topknot at the crown, wrapped with a narrow gold band, with a simple central part and short locks framing the temples, and a slender gold diadem band with a tiny leaf-shaped ornament at the center. On his forehead, show a thin horizontal white tripundra line with a small red dot in the middle. Costume him in era-accurate Pallava royal dress: a cream-colored, finely woven cotton angavastra draped over both shoulders and across the torso like a modest shawl, hinting at a pale-gold short-sleeved upper garment beneath. His lower garment is a richly pleated deep maroon dhoti wrapped at the waist and falling to the ankles, with a broad muted-gold border and thin dark-green stripes, front fan-pleats clearly visible. Tie the waist with a narrow dark-green cloth belt patterned in tiny geometric motifs. Put simple brown leather sandals on his feet. Adorn him with modest royal jewellery: layered gold necklaces (one short collar, one longer with a small Shiva-linga pendant), slim gold armlets on both upper arms, several thin gold bangles on each wrist, and small round gold stud earrings. At his left hip, show his signature weapon, a long slightly curved steel sword in a plain dark-brown wooden scabbard with modest brass fittings; the visible hilt has a disk pommel and short crossguard wrapped in dark cloth. Use a palette dominated by cream, deep maroon, muted gold, dark green, and brown, and present him front, side, and three-quarter views to emphasize consistent hair, face, draping, pleats, jewellery, and sword placement.
